faqs.q: How much does tree removal cost?
faqs.a: It depends on height, spread, species, how close it is to structures and how difficult the access is. A tree that can be felled in one piece into open ground costs a fraction of the same tree over a roof. That is why the estimate is done on site.
PLACEHOLDER — confirm actual emergency availability and response time before publishing. Do not claim 24/7 unless it is true.
Yes. Debris removal and a raked site are part of the job, not an extra line item.

faqs.q: Do I need permission to remove a tree?
faqs.a: Sometimes. Protected species, conservation areas and HOA rules all bite. We will tell you if we think a permission is needed before any work is booked.

faqs.q: Can you save a tree instead of removing it?
faqs.a: Often. Crown reduction, deadwood removal and bracing can buy a tree years. Removal is the last option, not the first quote.
PLACEHOLDER — state the actual insurance position. Tree work over structures is the one trade where clients genuinely check.
